title: The Terminal of Station Meridian
author: Yara Marchetti
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
